# Bravo: Uniswap V4 Hook Framework on X Layer

> Bravo is an open-source Uniswap V4 Hook implementation and routing framework deployed and verified on OKX's X Layer network.

## Project Summary
- Project Name: Bravo
- Organization: BravoZone
- GitHub Repository: https://github.com/BravoZone/bravo
- Category: Web3, DeFi, Automated Market Maker (AMM), Uniswap V4 Hooks, Layer 2 Infrastructure
- Ecosystem: X Layer (OKX Layer 2), Ethereum

## Technical Architecture
- Framework: Uniswap V4 BaseActionsRouter
- Smart Contract Language: Solidity
- Capabilities: Dynamic fee hooks, custom liquidity management, automated actions execution.
- Key Advantage: Engineered for high-throughput, ultra-low gas execution on X Layer rollup architecture.

## On-Chain Verification
- Network: X Layer Testnet
- Chain ID: 1952
- Contract Address: 0xb071ae4419a99fb0e9492b6d87516f70ecfc12a2
- Deployment Tx Hash: 0xa8011ae0eab90dfb86249eb513a6d54abdca112ae233debfe29cfd827df3683b
- Explorer: Verified on OKLink Explorer

## Quickstart Guide
```bash
git clone [https://github.com/BravoZone/bravo.git](https://github.com/BravoZone/bravo.git)
cd bravo
forge build
